text:
alex_dev: Quick summary from today's vendor sync with NVIDIA + Habana + AWS SI leads. We need to triage embargo windows, SI gating, and marketplace SKU sequencing for H100/H200/B200, MI300, Gaudi. Main ask: align on a launch cadence and who owns blocker mitigation.

priya_pm: Thanks Alex. Do we have hard embargo dates? I heard vendor legal asked for an embargo until 2025-06-15 for H200 materials.

alex_dev: Correct — NVIDIA asked us to hold external comms until 2025-06-15 for H200. Habana/Gaudi team asked for a short embargo ending ~2025-04-20. MI300 is more flexible but needs firmware validation first.

marco_partnerships: We should split announcement waves: Gaudi/MI300 (wave 1), H100/H200 (wave 2) with B200 as follow-up. Vendors prefer staggering to reduce press overlap.

jamie_eng: On the engineering side: blockers are driver cert, SI image validation, and marketplace AMI build. Short checklist I scribbled:
```
Component         | Owner        | Blocker
------------------|--------------|--------------------
Driver cert       | jamie_eng    | vendor QA signoff
SI image (AMI)    | sasha_sre    | kernel/firmware
Marketplace SKU    | eli_product  | pricing + SKU tags
Embargo window    | marco        | legal signoff
```

sasha_sre: Kernel/firmware issue on Gaudi still flakey in our lab; need vendor patch v0.9.3. I'll request hotfix.

eli_product: For marketplace gating, we need SKU IDs and pricing by 2025-04-01 to make wave 1. Can partnerships push vendors for SKU mapping?

marco_partnerships: Yes — I'll escalate. Also vendor asked for a joint SI readiness doc — we should produce a 1-pager for each vendor listing supported images and known limitations.

priya_pm: Action items: (1) marco to get SKU mapping & embargo confirmation (2) jamie to track driver cert ETA (3) sasha to request Gaudi firmware hotfix (4) eli to prep marketplace onboarding checklist. Tentative deadlines in thread.

alex_dev: Adding tentative dates from today's meeting:
- Gaudi SI dry-run: 2025-04-10 -> need firmware hotfix by 2025-03-28
- MI300 lab validation: 2025-04-20 -> driver v2.1 required by 2025-04-05
- H100 initial enable: 2025-05-10 -> image bake 2025-04-22
- H200 partner embargo lifts: 2025-06-15 -> public announce window 2025-06-16 to 2025-06-30

jamie_eng: I'll put these into our eng tracking board. Quick note: if we do aggressive batching on H200 we'll need to validate perf at 8k seq. Might surface later.

marco_partnerships: For joint announcements: vendors want embargo handshakes 72h prior to public. Recommend we require final slate 5 business days before embargo lift to prep marketplace pages and docs.

eli_product: Sounds good. Also need marketing assets (logo permissions, co-branding guidelines) — anyone who talks to vendor legal pls cc me.

priya_pm: Can we have a weekly 30m standup focused on HW onramps until Q3? Suggest Tuesdays 10am PT.

calendar-bot: Scheduled recurring weekly: "HW Onramp Standup" starting 2025-03-25 10:00 PT, invitees: alex_dev, priya_pm, marco_partnerships, jamie_eng, sasha_sre, eli_product.

alex_dev: Great. Last note: SI partners asked for a sandbox test account and an early AMI drop. sasha + jamie pls scope a small 'early access' package for 2 SIs.

sasha_sre: Will scope and post the access plan in #eng-infra by EOD Friday.

marco_partnerships: I'll draft the joint announcement cadence doc and share it here for review by EOD Monday. :thumbsup:

eli_product: If we hit these dates we can aim for marketplace availability aligned with vendor press windows. Good work team.

priya_pm: Thanks all — will track action items in the project board and follow up in the first standup.

alex_dev: Closing thread — please add any missing blockers. If none, let's treat these dates as the working schedule until changed.
